name: Rainwater Harvesting Calculator
description: Calculate harvestable rainwater volume from roof catchment area, annual rainfall, and roof material runoff coefficients, then size a storage tank.
search_intent: Calculate rainwater collection capacity and storage tank size from roof area and rainfall.

inputs.label: Roof surface material
inputs.help: Metal/Colorbond (0.95 efficiency), Concrete/Clay Tile (0.85), Asphalt Shingle (0.80), Flat Membrane (0.85)

calculation: Theoretical yield: 1 inch of rain on 1 ft² of roof equals 0.6233 US gallons (or 1 mm on 1 m² equals 1 liter). Material runoff coefficients: Metal = 0.95, Tile = 0.85, Shingle = 0.80, Membrane = 0.85. Net annual yield (gallons) = catchmentAreaFt2 × annualRainfallInches × 0.6233 × runoffCoefficient × (1 − filtrationLossPercent / 100). Liters = gallons × 3.78541. Monthly average = annual yield / 12. Recommended dry-period buffer tank capacity = (annual yield / 365) × storageDays.
limitations: Calculations use annual precipitation averages; seasonal rainfall clustering and dry seasons can require larger cisterns.
Potable water use requires certified multi-stage sediment filtration, UV disinfection, and municipal testing.
Local health departments and water districts may regulate rainwater catchment rights and overflow drainage.
